patches.applied_to: nothing at build time: the fork's commit is built as committed; the hunks are its commits' contents, and `patch_cumesh_win.py check` holds the commit equal to upstream + cubvh + the hunks
patches.check: equal: upstream 12289e106 + cubvh ce92267a2 + 31 hunks, file by file (README.md aside); eigen's link at e63d9f6cc
patches.why: the version (0.0.1.post4+cu128torch2.8) and no torch pin; cuBVH's build without Python's lock; cuBVH's card copy on demand (upload=False builds on the CPU only; upload(), release_device(), on_device; the queries upload first); fill_holes' chain in less card memory with the same tables bit for bit (get_edges: a DoubleBuffer sort, outputs of their exact length, its scratch freed; get_boundary_info and get_manifold_boundary_adjacency: counting iterators and exact outputs; fill_holes: the tables it no longer reads freed before the mesh buffers are extended), on upstream's stream handling; the ray-stab's inside test with an any-hit traversal (the same verdicts bit for bit); Pixal3D's memory edits of remeshing.py (chunked BVH queries and frees, value-neutral). Upstream's own Windows build (setup.py since f149d59) as it is
